New York Times journalists, if you still have any integrity left, resign immediately. 

Folllow the lead of Valerie Zink, who resigned from her job as a Reuters photojournalist rather than continue to be complicit in her company’s enablement of the Isr@ eli-American gen/ cide of the Palestinian people.

Resigning from The New York Times is the bare minimum. You owe it to your colleagues in Palestine, where over 270 Palestinian journalists have been murdered by the zio nist entity in the past 23 months (Al Jazeera), and your employer has had a direct role in these atrocities. 

How can you continue to work for a publication that refuses to even call the zio nist destruction of life in The G Strip a “gen ocide”? 

How can you continue to collect your paycheck from a company that consistently regurgitates Isr@ eli propaganda to justify the assasination of your brave collleagues in The G Strip, who risk their lives to document the genocide of their own people? 

How can you be proud to work for a company that is guilty of criminal journalistic malpractice by publishing and standing firmly behind a widely debunked article, “Screams without Words”, to manufacture consent for gen/ cide?

The New York Times has shown everyone that they might be unsalvageable as an institution. But your humanity is. Do the right thing and take that first step: #Resign from The New York Times. 

✂️ Cut ties with media that hides the truth.
